# Validation Checklist

## Spec traceability
- [ ] Every feature in code maps to an FR in the spec
- [ ] Every FR is implemented (or explicitly out-of-scope)

## API correctness
- [ ] All documented endpoints exist
- [ ] Validation rules implemented
- [ ] Error model consistent
- [ ] Contract tests cover happy + error paths

## Backend quality
- [ ] No business logic in controllers
- [ ] DTOs separated from domain
- [ ] Exceptions mapped to errors

## Frontend quality
- [ ] Strict typing enabled
